headline: STX token price surges 18% as DeFi yield opportunities expand on Stacks.
analysis: STX trading volume hit 42M USD in 24 hours on April 5. Yield on sBTC staking rose to 6.2% APY. Community governance vote on tokenomics proposal passed with 74% support. New NFT mint opened on Gamma.io attracting 1,200 unique wallets.
